subject: Next steps: scheduling product demo, procurement & security onboarding
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@prioryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposing next meeting windows

Hi Alex — great talking earlier. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: in-product assist for claims processing (low-latency inference, PII controls).
- Success metrics: reduce manual review by 40% and keep false-positive rate < 2%.
- Constraints flagged: on-prem data handling for PHI, strict retention and audit logs, SSO + SAML.

Next steps I propose:
1) 45–60 minute technical demo (platform + security walkthrough) with your security and procurement folks included.
2) Share a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can iterate on — scope, timeline, dependencies, decision owners.

Below are three proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-15: 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-12-16: 11:00–12:00
- Thu 2026-12-17: 13:30–14:30

If those don't work please share two alternatives and flag the security/procurement contacts to include. I attached a draft MAP and a template so we can quickly lock on owners.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-proposed-scope.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: MAP-template.xlsx (Excel)]

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@prioryhealth.com>

Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prioryhealth.com>, procurement@prioryhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-12T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing next meeting windows

Thanks Marcus — useful summary. Samira (security) and procurement are copied. A few notes up front:

- We do need to confirm whether any token-level telemetry leaves our VPC; Samira will confirm the exact requirement.
- Procurement is timing reviews this quarter and wants a high-level cost band before committing to a pilot.

From our side, the 16th at 11:00 PST works best.

Also including Samira: Samira, will you be able to join the 12/16 demo? If not, can you share an engineer who can cover security controls (audit logging, retention, KMS)?

- Alex
Alex Jordan

Thanks Alex — I can join the 12/16 11:00 PST slot. A couple quick asks for the demo so we can triage pre-reads:

- Please send an architecture slide that shows where data is processed/stored and which components touch PHI.
- Provide details on encryption at rest and in transit, and your recommended KMS integration patterns.

I can also run the SOC 2 checklist after the demo but would like to review a short evidence pack beforehand if possible (logs, retention policy, segmentation).

To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@prioryhealth.com>, Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@prioryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@prioryhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-12T17:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing next meeting windows

Perfect — thanks for confirming Samira + Alex. Locking the demo: 2026-12-16 11:00 PST (45 minutes). Calendar invite sent separately.

Samira — attaching a short architecture sketch and an evidence index so you can triage post-demo. High-level notes below:

- Data flow: customer data is ingested on-prem via edge connectors or VPC peering; inference can run in Dedicated/private mode so PHI does not leave customer-controlled infrastructure unless explicitly configured.
- KMS: we support AWS KMS and HSM integrations; keys can be customer-managed.
- Logs & retention: configurable event-level audit logs with retention policy per tenant; default 90 days but adjustable per contract.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-proposed-scope.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: architecture-overview.png (PNG)], [Attachment: evidence-index.docx (DOCX)]

Procurement — to help with budgeting, Marissa will follow up with a conservative cost band and pilot worksheet. Marissa, Karthik: can you put together the one-pager (pricing band + pilot timeline) by Monday EOD?

Thanks,
Marcus
—
Marcus Lin

- Budget band (conservative): $25k–$45k for the pilot (includes reserved capacity + engineering support).
- Key owners: Alex (Platform), Samira (Security), Raj (Procurement) — mapped in the attached MAP.

Attachments: [Attachment: pilot-one-pager.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: MAP-template-filled.xlsx (Excel)]
